fields.description: Weekly issue with Christmas-season editorials and local commentary on Miami and Miami Beach, including tourism and winter-season activity, nightlife and entertainment listings/ads, and sports coverage (notably greyhound racing at Miami Beach and golf). Includes an editorial praising Carl G. Fisher’s role in Miami Beach golf-course development, discussion of Tex Rickard’s investment in a Miami Beach dog track, and a reader letter addressing the quality and high cost of milk for children in Miami. Contains society columns, humorous “Dear Santa” letters, and extensive local business and event advertising.
